text:
mira_ng: Heads-up — provenance alerts spiked on seedbank-2 this morning, a lot of short non-English snippets flagged as 'ambiguous' during the canary run. Anyone else seeing it?

samir: saw the alert, looking now. model-canary-bot posted a 2x regression on our multilang recall for qcanary6b. :eyes:

model-canary-bot: Canary report: qcanary6b_v2 -> v3 comparison. metric: MultilangRecall@k dropped from 0.73 to 0.58 on seedbank-2. Possible source: increased near-duplicates + tokenization mismatch. Link: https://redwood.internal/canary/3729991234

oliver_r: My first guess is offboarding policy — we just retired the old lang-normalizer step in ingest for seedbank-2 last week. That could bump ambiguity for short fragments.

ada_ops: @mira_ng @samir I blocked the next autosync import for seedbank-2. Don't want more contaminated batches landing.

luis_labeler: if these are short fragments, labelers will mark many as "insufficient context" which biases the golden set. We should avoid mass relabeling until we triage.

mira_ng: Agreed. Quick plan proposal: 1) snapshot current seedbank-2 and mark as read-only; 2) run a dedupe pass focused on short (<20 char) multilingual tokens + normalize; 3) sample 200 ambig ones for labeler review with new instructions. Canary should run on the cleaned snapshot.

samir: I can run a tokenization diff job. Quick proto: 
```
SELECT id FROM seedbank2 WHERE char_length(text) < 20 AND language != 'en' LIMIT 2000;
```
Then run `nlp-normalize-v1` vs `nlp-normalize-v2` to get mismatch counts.

oliver_r: Also add a provenance tag to every item with ingest_pipeline_version. We don't have that on older items — that makes tracking harder.

mira_ng: We do have pipeline metadata for new items, but older ones don't. Let's tag the snapshot with `snapshot_ingest_version=legacy-2024-07` so the canary knows to ignore mixing.

ada_ops: I've created the snapshot: `seedbank2_offboard_2026-03-21`. URL: https://s3.redwood/seedbank2/offboard_3729991234

model-canary-bot: New canary scheduled: qcanary6b_v3 on seedbank2_offboard_3729991234 at +30m. Expect report ~3730000000.

luis_labeler: For the labeling batch: propose instruction snippet — "When a snippet lacks clear intent or context, tag as `insufficient_context` but provide language and likely domain if guessable. Avoid `noisy` unless clearly mangled."

mira_ng: Nice. Also add an explicit flag for "near-duplicate" if the same canonicalized string appears elsewhere in the snapshot. We'll use that to exclude from golden candidate pool.

samir: Running the tokenization diff now. Early find: 14% of the short non-en items change token count >1 between normalizers; many are punctuation-only or URL fragments.

oliver_r: If URLs are the culprit we should add an ingest rule to strip/placeholder them for short items. That will reduce spurious ambiguity.

mira_ng: Decision: hold golden updates until we 1) dedupe + normalize snapshot, 2) label 200 ambiguous samples, 3) rerun canary. If canary regression persists then open model-onboard rollback.

ada_ops: I'll coordinate labeler shift and create the batch. Assigning to @luis_labeler and two contractors. ETA for labeler pass: EOD today.

luis_labeler: On it. I'll post the instruction doc in #eng-ml once done. Quick Q: do we accept `insufficient_context` as gold-disqualifier?

mira_ng: Yes — `insufficient_context` excludes from golden and holdout pools but keep in a quarantine set for future augment.

samir: Canary completed early — model-canary-bot posted interim. Notable: after normalizing (nlg-normalize-v2), multilang recall improves to 0.70 on the snapshot. Still slightly below baseline but within noise.

model-canary-bot: Interim canary: qcanary6b_v3 on seedbank2_offboard_3729991234 — MultilangRecall@k: 0.70 (baseline 0.73). See full: https://redwood.internal/canary/3729991234/interim

oliver_r: That's encouraging. Next step: labeling pass + rerun final canary. If final <0.7 we might pin v2 for dedicated deployments.

mira_ng: Thanks team — please react with :thumbsup: when you've read and :white_check_mark: when your task is done. I'll follow up with a short postmortem if we end up rolling back.

luis_labeler: 👍 I'll update when batch is complete.

ada_ops: ✅ snapshot ready and batch created.

samir: ✅ token-diff job finished and uploaded diffs to the canary bucket.

mira_ng: Great. Closing the loop later today. If anyone spots other seedbanks with similar pattern ping me directly.
